newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Aztech launches new 96-voice sound card.
newsitem.headline: Aztech launches new 96-voice sound card.

text.p: Multimedia company Aztech Systems Ltd said on Monday it had launched a new WaveTable Synthesis sound card, the Aztech WaveRider Platinum-3D.

The product can play back 96 instruments simultaneously and is compatible with major sound standards, including Microsoft Windows Sound System, AdLib, Sound Blaster 2.0 and Sound Blaster ProII, Aztech said in a statement.
It said the new product will be sold in the retail market in the middle of August at a recommended price of US$79 each.
Aztech's sound card comes after the recent introduction of NovaStation, a multimedia software by Venture Manufacturing that can play back 128 instruments.
Creative Technology is also seeking to replace existing 16-bit sound cards and clone cards with its latest AWE64 audio product that plays back 64 instruments.
